entry.title: The blog page's filter in two levels
entry.content: The blog page's filter in two levels: the kinds (الكل 1078 / مقالات 962 / قصص 70 / كوميكس 46) as tabs on top with the search beside them, and under the tab chosen a panel cut its own way — the outlets' cards for every post and for the columns (each counting that kind, with «خارج الصحف»), the 14 serials for the stories («رفقاء الليل»، «معرض الموت»… with their episodes, where and when they ran, and «قصص منفردة»), the strands for the comics («مصر بالصور», more on Bos w Tol, «صبيان وبنات», «مجلة نور», «قعدة أصحاب»). The summary speaks for the kind («1078 منشورًا، منها 869 في 15…»), the chart puts the card chosen in front and the archive's piles follow it; blog.html#papers-<outlet> still opens on that outlet. In both themes and in English. Service worker, changelog and feeds rebuilt

entry.title: Utopia's character pages (علاء and جابر) open on a scene of their own
entry.content: Utopia's character pages (علاء and جابر) open on a scene of their own: the colony on one side — gold, villas with lit windows, palms and a pool under a low sun — and the Others' world on the other — grey dust, crowded blocks, a few lit windows — with a clear brick wall between them, barbed wire along its top and a searchlight sweeping the outside (still for reduced motion). Each hero stands on his own side, lit, the other dimmed; across the wall, that world's name, the novel's cover and the hero on the other side, so the two pages lead to each other. On a phone, one column, his own world behind him and no wall. In both themes and in English. Service worker, changelog and feeds rebuilt

entry.title: Utopia's character pages (علاء and جابر)
entry.content: Utopia's character pages (علاء and جابر): the wall in the hero stands in the gap between the cover and the words, not across the middle of the screen where it cut through the eyebrow and every line of the description; hidden on a phone, where the cover sits above the words. The side of his words is tinted gold for Alaa, inside the wall, and grey for Gaber, outside it, in Arabic and English. Service worker, changelog, feeds and sitemap rebuilt

entry.title: The blog page's «في الصحف» is now the top of its archive
entry.content: The blog page's «في الصحف» is now the top of its archive: the outlets' cards (with «خارج الصحف» for the 209 posts from no paper), the kinds and the search together as one filter, then his pieces in the papers year by year, then the archive's piles, which the outlet chosen narrows; the kinds and the search narrow the cards' counts (an outlet with none faded) and the chart too. blog.html#papers-<outlet> still opens on that outlet, and the outlet chosen is kept on coming back from an article. The old per-year list under it is gone (the archive shows the same posts), the cards are smaller, and the page's lead says the new order. Service worker, changelog, feeds and sitemap rebuilt

entry.title: «الطبعات» on the covers page
entry.content: «الطبعات» on the covers page: each edition's card in «رواياته وكتبه» shows its own cover, or else that of the same house's edition nearest in years («الغلاف من طبعة …»), or for a book all of whose editions are one house's the book's own cover, never another house's (63 cards showed the book's first cover, often another house's and year; one, «نادي القتال» from Dar Lila 2014, now says it has none yet). «بعد منتصف الليل» season 8 on Audiohat: its second episode, «أنا الفرخة واحنا الكتاكيت» (Sherine Hanaey, 6 November 2026), its length unknown (the page gives only the sample's); the third announced for 13 November. Service worker, changelog and feeds rebuilt

entry.title: «بالأرقام والأسلوب»'s «المسيرة» and «إحصاءات الموقع» are one step
entry.content: «بالأرقام والأسلوب»'s «المسيرة» and «إحصاءات الموقع» are one step: one set of 18 tiles (site-stats.js, which the page and tools/build-meta.js both read), each number once and with its Arabic plural, the 12 houses of his books and the 17 publishers and platforms now both 17; #stats leads to the tiles. The home page's «استكشف / ادخل المكتبة» has 18 cards for the site's main sections, adding سيرته, لقاءاته, بالأرقام والأسلوب, الأغلفة والطبعات, تقويم العرّاب and ما ينقص الأرشيف, each card's figure its own page's count (الإرث its events, not the interviews; الأعمال issues and books, not series and books). Service worker and changelog rebuilt

entry.title: Data, sitemap, feeds and service worker rebuilt and checked
entry.content: Data, sitemap, feeds and service worker rebuilt and checked: 57 pages and 9 redirects, every page in sitemap.xml (1,601 addresses) and no redirect in it, no internal link to a missing page or to a redirect, sitemap.xml, feed.xml and feed-en.xml well formed, the service worker's 273 files all there, the manifest's icons and shortcuts all there; every page loads at 1280 and 390 wide with no script error, no sideways scroll and no broken picture (median 428 ms locally). The changelog's Arabic line added for the seven rebuilds that had none

entry.title: «ركن القرّاء» (quiz.html) is gone, its six parts each a page of its own, all six in «شارك»'s panel under…
entry.content: «ركن القرّاء» (quiz.html) is gone, its six parts each a page of its own, all six in «شارك»'s panel under «العب واقرأ» beside the ways to add to the site (and in the phone's menu): «اختبر نفسك» (test.html, its fan of question cards), «أي شخصية أنت؟» (which-character.html: a band of the six characters in gilt oval frames, one lit at a time with what makes them so), «البدايات» (first-lines.html: a sheet in a typewriter, a first line typed on it a letter at a time and then «…من أي كتاب؟»), «بطاقة القارئ» (reader-card.html: a library borrowing card, his books down it, their years stamped in red, a round «قارئ» stamp), «صمّم غلافك» (cover-maker.html: pocket covers in his series' looks, untitled, the reader's own in the middle with its title a blinking caret) and «اقرأ معنا» (read-with-us.html: the months as a row of covers, this month's book raised and lit). quiz.html leads to them, #who, #openings, #card, #cover and #club each to its page; the shared pictures and invitations carry the new addresses; «إرثه»'s panel and the footer no longer list it; the site map, sitemap.xml and the search words name the six

entry.title: «حكايات القرّاء» and «بخط يده» are one page, «حكايات القرّاء وبخط يده» (reader-stories.html)
entry.content: «حكايات القرّاء» and «بخط يده» are one page, «حكايات القرّاء وبخط يده» (reader-stories.html): his readers and him, both ways — the readers' stories with their reel and how to send one, then «بخط يده» (#hand): what he wrote by hand for his readers, his books' printed dedications (#dedications) and the card-form for a dedication of one's own (#send); chips at the top to each part. One band for both: «بخط يده»'s ruled sheet in the middle, the pen writing «إلى القارئ العزيز.. ابق حيًا حتى اللقاء القادم» and signing it, and the readers' polaroids of his covers tossed around it, never over the writing (on a phone, smaller, a column each side); the sheet leads to «بخط يده». handwriting.html leads to the page, keeping #dedications and #send; the menus, the search words, the site map, sitemap.xml, the description and the GitHub form's note name the one page

entry.title: «دراسات ورسائل عنه» is a page of its own (studies.html), no longer the end of «قالوا عنه»
entry.content: «دراسات ورسائل عنه» is a page of its own (studies.html), no longer the end of «قالوا عنه»: the 35 theses and peer-reviewed articles about him, theses first and journal articles beside them, each with where and when, its record's link and the book it reads, and a chip for each country (Egypt 15, Algeria 9, Iran 3…). Its band: the nine theses bound in cloth on a wooden shelf, their years in gold on the spines and the doctorate the tallest, the journals stacked beside them under their count; each leads to its entry. tributes.html#studies leads to it; in «إرثه»'s panel, the footer, the search words, the site map, sitemap.xml and its own description

entry.title: «سيرته ولقاءاته» splits into three pages
entry.content: «سيرته ولقاءاته» splits into three pages: «سيرته» (talks.html) keeps his life in six chapters and gets a band of its own — his life as one line, a stretch for each chapter as long as its years, each leading to it; «لقاءاته» (interviews.html) takes the interviews, talks, films and articles with the wall of old television sets; «طنطا، مدينته» (tanta.html) is a page again, under a band of the town at dusk, the Badawi mosque among its roofs, 1962 and 2018 at its sides. Old links to talks.html#talks and #tanta lead to the new pages, and a year's video in «سيرته» goes to its card on «لقاءاته». In «حياته»'s panel, the phone's menu, the footer, the search words, the site map, sitemap.xml and the descriptions. And «في مثل هذا اليوم» leaves the calendar page, since the calendar's open day already shows it

entry.title: «أعلام في حكاياته» has a new band
entry.content: «أعلام في حكاياته» has a new band: an investigation board — cork in a wooden frame — of the nine issues where several of its figures meet: each issue's cover pinned, the names met in it on paper tags above and below it (their years beside them, a line of their kind's colour on top), a red thread from the cover to each — Pasteur with Koch, Loeffler, Yersin, Hansen and Reed; Freud, Adler and Jung; Verne and Wells; Ross, Manson and Grassi… A tag leads to its card, a cover to its issue; «التقوا في عدد واحد» on a brass plate in the frame. Each group as wide as its names need, nothing over anything; on a phone the board scrolls sideways in its frame

entry.title: The day his translations and stories for others came out, sent by the site's editor
entry.content: The day his translations and stories for others came out, sent by the site's editor: «رجفة الخوف»'s ten issues — 1 on 19 January 2003, 2 on 26 May 2003, 3 on 15 January 2004, 4 on 2 January 2005, 5 on 15 December 2005, 6 in 2006, 7 on 11 June 2007, 8 on 5 January 2008, 9 on 15 July 2008, 10 on 27 December 2009 — and the series' years, 2003–2009; «ثلاثة» in «كتاب الصيف» on 28 May 2003; «أسطورة بلية» (بلية العجيب 17) on 5 June 2004. Each as its issue's first edition, with its year: on its page, in «السلاسل جنبًا إلى جنب», and on its day in «تقويم العرّاب» and «في مثل هذا اليوم» (990 moments now)

entry.title: Two videos about him on «الإرث» (AKT.media)
entry.content: Two videos about him on «الإرث» (AKT.media): «كل يوم» on ON, a segment on «العرّاب» in the days after his death (5 April 2018, 38 minutes), and «آخر النهار» on Al Nahar, Ibrahim Eissa speaking of him (29 November 2020, 8 minutes); each also under its year on «ذكراه كل عام». «أعلام في حكاياته» has a new band: a frieze of the 42 names — three rows sliding slowly, each the other way, the middle one in outline, the most met first — beside each the years they lived, taken from their note, and a dot in the colour of their kind; a row stops under the pointer and a name leads to its card, as before. No names over one another now, and the title closer under it

entry.title: «روايات عالمية للجيب» has its years
entry.content: «روايات عالمية للجيب» has its years: 66 of its issues dated from their own Goodreads editions (the Arabic edition's date, not the original novel's) — one about every three months from #8 (April 1994) to #74 (October 2010), then #75–80 from 2012 to January 2015 (AKT.otherSeries, issue.year, data-series-more.js). Left out where Goodreads gives only the original's date (13, 18, 25, 35, 42, 43, 81) or a date out of turn (68); 1–7 and 82–83 not found. «السلاسل جنبًا إلى جنب» shows 1994–2015 «from #8 to #80, as their editions date them», and the series has its lane in the band, with its 77 issues; each issue's year shows on its series page

entry.title: «السلاسل جنبًا إلى جنب» has «روايات عالمية للجيب», the line of world novels he translated and adapted from…
entry.content: «السلاسل جنبًا إلى جنب» has «روايات عالمية للجيب», the line of world novels he translated and adapted from its 7th issue to its 83rd: his part in it in place of a narrator, its 77 issues (#7–83), the first and the last with their covers, its house and its kind; its issues are read where a series by others keeps them (AKT.otherSeries), as every series page does. Its years are not known yet, so it has a dash there and no lane in the band; a line of separate novels has no ending of its own, so a dash there too. «السلاسل السبع» now, counted

entry.title: «حكايات القرّاء»
entry.content: «حكايات القرّاء»: its band is now his covers tossed on the page as polaroids, after Toc's «Scattered Polaroids — CSS random()»: two dozen issues and novels, each a little off true, turned and shadowed its own way, placed where it covers no other by more than about a third, dropping in one after another; one under the pointer lifts and straightens. On the page itself — no ground of its own and no line under it. The reel's arrows are drawn chevrons: the ❮ ❯ characters were mirrored by right-to-left text, so in Arabic they pointed against the way their buttons go

entry.title: «ذكراه كل عام»
entry.content: «ذكراه كل عام»: the candles stand on the page itself — no ground of their own and no line under them, in either theme, only a warm light around the flames, and the title closer under them. «حكايات القرّاء» opens on a reel of polaroids, after two pens — Chris Bolson's «Scroll-Driven Photo Gallery» (white polaroids with a handwritten caption growing out of nothing as they scroll into place, markers and arrows between them) and Toc's «Stacked Card Scroll Effect» (each card, once seen, scaling down and flying out along a curve, turning, onto a stack): as the page scrolls, each polaroid rises full size to the middle, then flies onto one of two piles, one each side. Until a story is published they are his covers asking a story's questions — «أول عدد قرأته له؟» on Ma Wara' al-Tabi'a 1, «من أعطاك إياه؟», «أين كنت تقرؤه؟», «ماذا ترك فيك؟» on Utopia, «هل التقيته؟» on his photograph, «أين كنت يوم رحل؟» on his grave — and a blank one, «حكايتك هنا», that leads to writing it; then the stories themselves. The captions in Aref Ruqaa (SIL OFL, kept on the site); still, as a row on a table, for those who ask for less motion

entry.title: A look over the whole site
entry.content: A look over the whole site. The twelve pages about his world and his reading load only their own part of data-pages.js — «وحوش وأساطير» its monsters, «زمن العرّاب» its years — written by tools/build-data.js to assets/js/pages/<part>.js (each page about 50–75 KB lighter compressed; «اقتباسات» needs none, its phrases being in data-built.js already), and the offline copy no longer stores data-pages.js whole; its stale first copy of Fantasia's worlds, overridden by the second, is gone. «الأعمال» and «من أين أبدأ؟» load the same GSAP as the home page (3.13.0, jsDelivr), so a reader downloads it once. «حفظ للقراءة دون اتصال» says how much it saves as measured at each build (about 55 MB, AKT.stats.offlineMB), not «about 100 MB». The app's screenshots for installing it are new — the home page, the legacy, the cassette, the works and the characters as they look now, with the new menu (the phone ones at a true 412 px). Checked: every page's title, description, canonical, share tags and picture and structured data agree; every script and stylesheet a page names exists; every page draws without an error; the sitemap, the feeds and the service worker rebuilt

entry.title: After him, five new parts
entry.content: After him, five new parts. «ما صدر بعد رحيله» on the Works page (#after, posthumous.js): the ten books that came out after 2 April 2018, from «أفراح المقبرة» to «ألغام في بحر الذكريات», each with its date, how long after his death, its kind and its house. «الجيل الذي صنعه» on «دائرته» (#generation): fourteen writers and filmmakers who say they grew up on his books, a face and what each said with its source, each to their page. «الوداع، يومًا بيوم» on «قالوا عنه» (#farewell): from Monday 2 April 2018 to the end of May, each day with its events and the faces of those who spoke of him that day, opening their cards. «ذكراه كل عام» (remembrance.html), a new page: every anniversary from the first in 2019 to the eighth, each with the year's events, books, tributes and articles, the anniversary's own day marked, the days to the next one, and a band of a candle a year. «حكايات القرّاء» (reader-stories.html), a new page, and a step of «تواصل وساهم» (#stories): readers' own stories of him, sent by email or on GitHub and published only with leave (AKT.readerStories, data-readers.js — none yet). The two pages are in «إرثه»'s panel, under «اكتشف أكثر», in the phone's menu and on the site map

entry.title: The main menu
entry.content: The main menu: World Fiction floats along «من أين أبدأ؟» with its own front cover (covers/fronts/rwg.webp); Refaat's card is in the dark, as his page is, so his lantern's light shows; Alaa's heartbeat is drawn at the card's scale — a wide line squeezed into it had thinned the beat to nothing — brighter, its beat at the row's start (the right in Arabic) and the line running from it behind him

entry.content: «كلمة اليوم · بكلماته» moves from the home page to the Works page, under «في مثل هذا اليوم» (as that one did before it): the same line of his for everyone on the same day — a quote or a phrase from «قاموس العرّاب», in turn — with its place on the quotes page and «صورة», now drawn by today.js
